Laboratory Test Report.overall_description: A realistic medical laboratory test report with dense structured text and numerical results.
Laboratory Test Report.layout_structure: Hospital or laboratory name at the top, patient information below, a large multi-row test result table in the center, and doctor information and report date at the bottom.

Medical Examination Report.overall_description: A formal medical examination report summarizing multiple physical examination items and findings.
Medical Examination Report.layout_structure: Institution name and examinee information at the top, multiple examination sections or tables in the middle, and an overall conclusion with doctor information at the bottom.

Diagnostic Report.overall_description: A realistic clinical diagnostic report containing patient information, symptoms, findings, and a medical conclusion.
Diagnostic Report.layout_structure: Patient and visit information at the top, clinical findings and diagnostic details in the main body, followed by diagnosis, recommendations, doctor name, and date.

Imaging Report.overall_description: A formal medical imaging report containing examination information, imaging findings, and diagnostic impressions.
Imaging Report.layout_structure: Institution and patient information at the top, imaging examination details and findings in the middle, and diagnostic impression with doctor information at the bottom.

Academic Transcript.overall_description: A formal academic transcript containing dense course records, grades, credits, and cumulative academic information.
Academic Transcript.layout_structure: Institution and student information at the top, a large multi-row course table in the center, followed by semester statistics, cumulative GPA, credits, and issue information at the bottom.

Examination Result Report.overall_description: A structured examination result report showing subject-level scores, rankings, and performance statistics.
Examination Result Report.layout_structure: Institution and examination title at the top, student information below, a central score table with multiple subjects, followed by total score, ranking, and summary information.

Grade Report.overall_description: A compact academic grade report summarizing a student's grades across multiple courses or assessment components.
Grade Report.layout_structure: School and student information at the top, a structured grade table in the middle, and overall academic summary and issue information at the bottom.

Credit Record.overall_description: A formal academic credit record documenting completed courses, earned credits, and degree progress.
Credit Record.layout_structure: Institution and student information at the top, a multi-row credit record table in the center, and total earned credits with program requirement information at the bottom.

Lawyer Letter.overall_description: A formal lawyer letter describing a legal dispute, claim, obligation, or requested action in dense professional text.
Lawyer Letter.layout_structure: Law firm or sender information at the top, recipient and reference information below, several structured paragraphs describing the matter, followed by requested action, deadline, lawyer information, and date.

Legal Opinion.overall_description: A professional legal opinion document analyzing a specific legal issue with structured facts, reasoning, and conclusions.
Legal Opinion.layout_structure: Title and client information at the top, followed by sections for background, legal issue, analysis, conclusion, and professional information at the bottom.

Dispute Record.overall_description: A structured dispute record documenting the parties, disputed issue, timeline, claims, and current resolution status.
Dispute Record.layout_structure: Case or dispute information at the top, party details below, a chronological record or structured sections in the main body, followed by current status and responsible personnel.

Case Fact Record.overall_description: A factual case record summarizing involved parties, key events, evidence references, and documented statements.
Case Fact Record.layout_structure: Case identification and parties at the top, factual background and chronological events in the main body, followed by evidence references, notes, recorder information, and date.

Product Quality Inspection Report.overall_description: A formal product quality inspection report containing product information, multiple inspection items, measured results, standards, and pass or fail conclusions.
Product Quality Inspection Report.layout_structure: Inspection organization and product information at the top, a large multi-row inspection result table in the center, followed by an overall conclusion, inspector information, and report date.

Food Inspection Report.overall_description: A structured food inspection report containing sample information, laboratory test items, measured values, regulatory limits, and inspection conclusions.
Food Inspection Report.layout_structure: Testing organization and food sample information at the top, a dense laboratory result table in the center, and inspection conclusion with analyst and date information at the bottom.

Environmental Test Report.overall_description: A technical environmental test report documenting measurement locations, environmental parameters, numerical readings, standards, and compliance results.
Environmental Test Report.layout_structure: Testing organization, project, and location information at the top, multiple measurement tables in the main body, followed by compliance conclusions and testing personnel.

Equipment Inspection Report.overall_description: A technical equipment inspection report documenting equipment identification, inspection checkpoints, observed conditions, measurements, and operational conclusions.
Equipment Inspection Report.layout_structure: Equipment and inspection information at the top, a multi-row checklist or result table in the center, and final status with inspector and date at the bottom.

Appraisal Report.overall_description: A professional appraisal report evaluating an item, condition, value, or technical characteristic using structured observations and conclusions.
Appraisal Report.layout_structure: Appraisal organization and subject information at the top, evaluation criteria and detailed findings in the middle, followed by appraisal conclusion, estimated result, appraiser, and date.

Shipping Label.overall_description: A dense parcel shipping label containing sender, recipient, routing, package, and tracking information arranged in compact blocks.
Shipping Label.layout_structure: Carrier and tracking information at the top, sender and recipient address blocks in the center, package and routing details below, with barcode or QR-code areas and handling information.

Waybill.overall_description: A structured logistics waybill documenting shipment parties, goods information, transportation details, and delivery requirements.
Waybill.layout_structure: Waybill number and logistics provider at the top, sender and consignee information below, shipment details in a central table, and transport, fee, and signature information at the bottom.

Delivery Record.overall_description: A structured delivery record documenting shipment details, delivery time, recipient status, and completion information.
Delivery Record.layout_structure: Delivery identification and recipient information at the top, shipment and delivery details in the middle, followed by status, remarks, recipient confirmation, and delivery personnel.

Proof of Delivery.overall_description: A formal proof-of-delivery document recording shipment identification, delivery details, recipient confirmation, and completion status.
Proof of Delivery.layout_structure: Shipment and recipient information at the top, delivery details and confirmation fields in the center, followed by recipient name, signature area, courier information, and timestamp.

Logistics Tracking Record.overall_description: A logistics tracking record showing a chronological sequence of shipment status updates, locations, timestamps, and handling events.
Logistics Tracking Record.layout_structure: Tracking number and shipment summary at the top, followed by a long chronological tracking timeline or table containing multiple logistics events and locations.

Attendance Record.overall_description: A structured employee attendance record containing daily working times, attendance status, leave information, and monthly statistics.
Attendance Record.layout_structure: Organization, employee, and month information at the top, a large date-based attendance table in the center, followed by totals for attendance, absence, leave, and overtime.

Performance Report.overall_description: A structured employee performance report documenting evaluation criteria, scores, comments, achievements, and overall assessment.
Performance Report.layout_structure: Employee and evaluation period information at the top, performance criteria and scores in a central table, followed by comments, overall rating, evaluator information, and date.

Work Incident Record.overall_description: A formal workplace incident record documenting involved personnel, event details, consequences, actions taken, and follow-up information.
Work Incident Record.layout_structure: Organization and incident identification at the top, event details and involved personnel in the main body, followed by consequences, corrective action, responsible personnel, and record date.

Meeting Record.overall_description: A formal meeting record containing meeting information, participant details, agenda items, discussion notes, decisions, and action items.
Meeting Record.layout_structure: Meeting title, date, location, and participants at the top, followed by agenda items and structured discussion notes, with decisions and assigned action items at the bottom.

Employment Record.overall_description: A structured employment record documenting an employee's organizational role, employment period, position changes, and work status.
Employment Record.layout_structure: Organization and employee identification at the top, employment details and chronological position records in the center, followed by current status and record information.
